integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The bundled numerical checker is corroborative and is not used as evidence for the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Massless one-dimensional plastic walk only; nonzero mass/phase is not covered.
Diagonal position algebra only; the magnetic Weyl-operator setting is not covered.
Periodic lattices use the weighted cycle metric rather than the infinite-line metric.
Vanishing local cosine values are excluded from the finite-edge-length statement.
title: Exact weighted transport law for inhomogeneous plastic quantum walks
